value.rationale: For a small but natural minimal fully symmetric habitat network, establishes a complete triage of relative extinction-time uncertainty by initial occupancy: positive colonization has a unique finite volatility maximum from one or two initial patches, but monotone dispersion from three. Explicit exponential-law crossover, two separate optimizer ratios, and their ordering give directly interpretable risk regimes beyond the classical increasing-mean-persistence comparison. Not a rename of generic moment recursions because the global sign/uniqueness phase diagram needs the polynomial analysis. It is restricted in scope and not claimed to be a general conservation policy.
